reasons.plausibility: The mechanism of nano-precipitation strengthening and corrosion resistance enhancement by chromium-rich phases is scientifically sound, though exact phase stability and precipitation control need verification.
reasons.testability: The proposed experiment with side-by-side tests of treated and untreated alloys under standardized mechanical and corrosion protocols would clearly decide the issue.
